notes: «كلهم عن حماد بن زيد» gives three co-transmitters at one level; they all receive from حماد بن زيد
«- قال أبو كامل - حدثنا حماد» is the editor's note that Abu Kamil's own line reads «حدثنا حماد»; it repeats the same man at the same level, so it is one link and not a second
The Companion is Ibn Umar; «فقال عبد الله» in the story is him
